text:
liz: Kicking off coordinated window for ORCH-433 + DB migration (v12) in 15m. This touches api, runtime, console, router and the user-metadata DB. Order matters: pin -> pre-mig canary (read-only) -> migration -> runtime warm -> header flip -> ramp. @omar you own router/header flip and migration orchestration; @dan you own monitoring/rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy ORCH-433 by liz. Window: 2026-03-24T05:00Z - 05:45Z. Canary targets: 5% (5m) -> 20% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100%.

liz: Short runbook: 1) apply pins 2) start pre-mig canary (read-only) 3) run migration with safety flag `--online` 4) wait for runtime KV warm & schema_ready 5) flip router headers 6) ramp. If migration reports any row-lock timeout or >0.5% client 5xx during canary, abort and rollback.

omar: ACK. Ill coordinate the DB migration steps with `dbmigrator run v12 --online --shard=all` and pin router after `schema_ready`. Will post exact pin commands when at terminal.

maria: QA notes: keep `console.feature_preview` OFF during migration to avoid schema reads from new path. Smoke scripts: `smoke api-readonly`, `smoke console-login`, `smoke runtime-kv`.

dan: Monitoring/rollback: watch p95 latency, DB lock-waits, and client 5xx. Triggers: DB migration step shows >5% rows retried OR DB lock-wait >30s OR sustained 3m p95 >300ms. Rollback command (manual): `/deploy rollback ORCH-433 --services router,console,runtime,api` (reverse apply order). If migration partially applied, we run `dbmigrator revert v12` (manual ops only).

--- pinned versions to apply before pre-mig canary ---

```
api: v2.11.0-dbcompat
runtime: v4.3.0-eviction-fix
console: release/2026-03-24-ORCH-433
router: v1.13.1-shim
```

deploy-bot: Pre-mig canary started (5% read-only). Hooked: smoke scripts and `dbmigrator dry-run` validators.

omar: Pre-mig canary ok. Running `dbmigrator run v12 --online --shard=all --timeout=120s`. Will stream logs.

deploy-bot: Migration step started.

maria: Noted: pausing header flip until migrate reports `schema_ready`. Give runtime 60-90s to warm caches.

omar: Migration progress: shard-1 done, shard-2 running. Seeing a small retry bump on shard-2 (~0.8%). Pausing migration to investigate, marking hold.

dan: Holding at pre-mig canary. Observed DB transient retries on shard-2; retry rate spiked to 0.8% for 45s then fell to 0.2%. No client 5xx. Recommend continue but slow the migration concurrency.

omar: Lowering concurrency and resuming: `dbmigrator set-concurrency 4` then resume.

deploy-bot: Migration resumed.

maria: Runtime warm confirmed after migration: KV cache hitrate >90%. Schema_ready true.

omar: Pinning router and preparing header flip: `deployctl pin router v1.13.1-shim --namespace=prod` then `deployctl flip-header router --header X-Use-New: true --target=canary`.

deploy-bot: Canary header flip applied (canary only). Monitoring for 5xx/route-404s.

maria: Reminder: console.feature_preview stays OFF until router returns green.

dan: Monitoring: p95 steady, p50 minor uptick +15ms. No significant 5xx. DB lock-waits cleared. Continue to 20% for 10m.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp to 20% applied. Canary-2 active.

maria: Running full smoke at 20%. Call out any missing routes or login failures.

maria: smoke api-readonly OK, smoke console-login OK, runtime-kv-health OK.

omar: Header flip on canary looks clean. Proceeding to full header flip when we hit 50% stability.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% applied. Canary-3 active.

dan: Note: at ~50% we saw a 30s window with increased connection churn in router logs. p50 spiked by 60ms for ~2m, but no user errors. Filing ticket RED-1180. If it repeats or client 5xx >0.5%: rollback.

maria: Keeping close watch. Any objections to proceeding to 100%?

omar: No objections, proceeding to full rollout.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started. ORCH-433 -> 100% traffic.

maria: Rollout complete. Tag ORCH-433/2026-03-24. Thanks team. Follow-up: add migration concurrency guard to runbook and note the router connection churn.

dan: Stand down on monitor after 30m unless triggered. Filed RED-1180 for the churn and RED-1181 for migration retry tuning.

liz: Closing thread in 1h if no issues. Postmortem prep in #postmortems if anything came up.

omar: One post-rollout note: we had a manual hold when shard-2 retry hit 0.8% and we lowered concurrency; that prevented wider impact. Will add that step to runbook.
